title.narrative: Gearing up to end TB in Zimbabwe - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Tuberculosis, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: By 2026, a Zimbabwe “free of TB” with a goal of 80% reduction in TB incidence and mortality. By 2026 to have reduced the incidence of all forms of TB by 80% from 242/100000 in 2015 to 48/100 000. By 2026 to have reduced mortality of all forms of TB by 80% from 40/100000 in 2015 to 8/100 000.. The objectives of this program are: To reduce TB related deaths among people living with HIV by 80% by 2026. To increase the treatment coverage of drug sensitive TB from 83% in 2018 to 90% by 2026. To increase the treatment success rate of patients with drug susceptible TB from 83% in 2017 to 90% by 2026. To cumulatively detect 2,267 patients with RR/MDR TB between 2021 and 2026. To increase the treatment success rate of patients with RR/MDR TB from 57% (2016) to 75% by 2026

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for ZWE-T-MOHCCP04
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Contact investigation coverage: Proportion of contacts of people with bacteriologically confirmed TB evaluated for TB among those eligible
Percentage of people who completed TPT out of those who initiated TB preventive treatment
Percentage of laboratories that have electronic test ordering and results return capability via a remote test order module of the LIMS
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Outcome indicators targets and results for ZWE-T-MOHCCP04
TBP-1-Other 1 Number children under 5 in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
On-shelf availability: Percentage of facilities with tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) available on the day of the visit or day of reporting

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
TBDT-1-Other 1 Number of women with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB

Treatment coverage of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of notified people with bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated people with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
